note: Counts measured on emitted files. arrival_inversions is recounted from the files (event-order neighbours whose sync order is reversed), not from the injection counter, because window-edge trimming can remove one side of an injected inversion.

arrival_inversions.detail: A scan syncs after its successor, so arrival order != event order. Any consumer trusting arrival order derives wrong parcel states — measured by the M6 control-total experiment.

duplicate_scans.detail: Same scan_id re-uploaded with a later sync_time. Dedup must key on scan_id keeping first-by-event/latest-by-sync.

parcels_missing_scan.detail: One intermediate HUB_IN/HUB_OUT missing; trail has a gap but valid endpoints.

late_sync_hub_scans.detail: Every scan at this hub syncs 2-8h late — a systematic uplink problem, visible as a hub-shaped hole in arrival dashboards.

pii_phone_on_every_event.detail: customer_phone rides on every scan event and must be masked in silver with a restricted mapping table.
